imran.englead: Trying to press prod for the 1.23.4 rollout but I don’t have deployer role after laptop swap. Getting MFA denied.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: Deploy blocked: user missing role `prod_deployer` or device not MFA-enrolled. See /deploy logs for details.
sam-sre: @imran.englead you can request JIT via infra-ops, or I can open a temporary token. What’s the change window? :clock1:
imran.englead: Need it in the next 30m. This is a hotfix for the tokenization bug (repro steps in the PR). Can we fast-track? If we can't get prod, we'll have to roll a backported patch later.
alice.dev: FYI two integration tests flaked in the last run (timeout on redis). Not blocking but worth knowing. Do we need to pin the model-serving image or can we roll forward? :thinking_face:
carla-oncall: If we fast-track, pin to `service:v1.23.4-hotfix-2026-03-20` and run canary (5% traffic) for 10m. Rollback plan: immediate revert to `v1.23.3` if error rate > 1%.
bob-release: Add a short release note line: "Fix tokenization regression affecting 2-grams in embeddings; no schema changes." I'll update changelog once deploy goes.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: /deploy attempt by imran.englead rejected at 1768999999. Reason: MFA not verified. Audit id: abcd-20260320-17. Required approver: any member of group `releases-schedule` or `eng-managers`.
sam-sre: I can create a short-lived deploy token (10m). If @maria-engmgr approves, I’ll hand it to @imran.englead. That token will be logged and auto-expire.
maria-engmgr: Approved for emergency hotfix. Granting `prod_deployer` to imran.englead for 15 minutes. Please follow the checklist: 1) pin image, 2) canary 5%, 3) monitor errors, 4) document revert command. :white_check_mark:

```
# deploy steps
/deploy service --image service:v1.23.4-hotfix-2026-03-20 --canary 5%
kubectl rollout status deployment/service -w
# monitor
sloctl query errors --last 10m
```
